title: Annabelle Joynes Thompson
repository: Delaware Native American Archives / Mitsawokett Collection
transcriber: Archival Transcriber / Written in the Genome
citation: "Annabelle Joynes Thompson." Historical Document Record (2001). Preserved in the Nanticoke & Moor Historical Archive (Written in the Genome Collection).
lines: Funeral program cover: 'In Loving Memory of ANNABELLE THOMPSON - Sunrise October 28, 1928 - Sunset August 21, 2001.' Portrait of Annabelle Joynes Thompson on the cover. She was the wife of Samuel Thompson Jr. (profile 8169) and is archive profile 8212 ('Annabell Thompson'). The archive profile records her birth year as 1925 and her death as August 24, 2001; the program's dates (October 28, 1928 and August 21, 2001) govern under the archive owner's obituary-override rule and are corrected in her correction package. Photographed and supplied by Jequan Davis, 2026-11-23.
